sections.clause: Refusal to take back or withdraw goods or to refund the consideration thereof paid within the period stipulated, or failure to issue a cash memo or bill, or making false representations regarding standard, quality or warranty.

sections.section: Section 84 - Product Liability Action against Manufacturer
sections.clause: A product manufacturer shall be liable in a product liability action if the product contains a manufacturing defect, is defective in design, or deviates from manufacturing specifications.

sections.section: Section 85 - Product Liability Action against Service Provider
sections.clause: A service provider shall be liable for deficiency in service, negligence, or failure to conform to express warranties.

sections.section: Right to Repair & Implied Warranty of Merchantability
sections.clause: Goods sold must be reasonably fit for the general purpose for which they are manufactured; latent defects present at delivery void restrictive return windows.

dispute_scenarios.support_bot_initial_reply: We apologize, but your 7-day replacement window expired on September 22. As per policy, please visit an authorized service center 45 km away.
dispute_scenarios.legal_counter_strategy: Invoke CPA 2019 Section 84 for latent panel defect. Mandate doorstep inspection or immediate RMA courier replacement within 5 working days.

dispute_scenarios.issue_type: Physical Transit Damage / Shattered Glass Basket
dispute_scenarios.support_bot_initial_reply: As the delivery was marked successfully signed, physical damage is not covered unless an uninterrupted unboxing video is provided.
dispute_scenarios.legal_counter_strategy: Cite Section 2(47) Consumer Protection Act regarding unilateral unboxing video mandates as an Unfair Trade Practice, citing courier delivery weight logs.
